en.success_message: Signed in as %s. Your IM account is now connected.
en.success_hint: You can close this page and return to your MCP client.
en.error_hint: Close this page and start the connection again from your MCP client.
en.err_invalid_client: The client is not registered with this server. Reconnect the MCP server in your client.
en.err_invalid_redirect_uri: The redirect URI is not allowed for this client.
en.err_link_expired: This link has expired or was already used. Start again.
en.err_identity_mismatch: The IM account you signed in with does not match the account connected to this MCP session.
en.err_access_revoked: Access for this account has been revoked. Contact your administrator.
en.err_upstream: The IM service could not complete the sign-in. Try again in a moment.
en.err_app_not_configured: The IM app is not configured yet. Ask the operator to run npm run secret:set-im-app.
en.err_store_failed: Your sign-in could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
en.err_server: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.
en.qr_intro: After you scan, this MCP client acts as you in WeCom (calendar, documents, contacts, and more).
en.qr_warning: Only scan a code on a page you opened yourself. If someone sent you this link, do not scan it.
en.qr_bind_existing: WeCom asks whether to create a new bot or bind an existing one. If you authorized before, choose bind existing bot and pick the same bot; a new bot loses edit access to objects the old bot created.
en.qr_no_image: The QR code could not be generated. Open the link, finish in WeCom, then come back to this page.
en.qr_failed: Authorization did not complete. Start again from your MCP client.
en.qr_timeout: Timed out. Start again from your MCP client.

zh.success_message: 已以 %s 的身份登录，IM 账号已连接。
zh.success_hint: 可以关闭本页面，回到 MCP 客户端。
zh.error_hint: 请关闭本页面，在 MCP 客户端中重新发起连接。
zh.err_invalid_client: 该客户端未在本服务注册，请在客户端中重新连接 MCP 服务器。
zh.err_invalid_redirect_uri: 该客户端不允许使用此回调地址。
zh.err_link_expired: 链接已过期或已被使用，请重新开始。
zh.err_identity_mismatch: 你登录的 IM 账号与当前 MCP 会话绑定的账号不一致。
zh.err_access_revoked: 该账号的访问权限已被撤销，请联系管理员。
zh.err_upstream: IM 服务暂时无法完成登录，请稍后重试。
zh.err_app_not_configured: IM 应用尚未配置，请联系运维执行 npm run secret:set-im-app。
zh.err_store_failed: 登录信息保存失败，请稍后重试。
zh.err_server: 服务器出现错误，请稍后重试。
zh.qr_intro: 扫码后，该 MCP 客户端将以你本人的企业微信身份访问日程、文档、通讯录等。
zh.qr_warning: 只扫你自己打开的页面上的二维码。如果这个链接是别人发给你的，请不要扫。
zh.qr_bind_existing: 企业微信会询问新建机器人还是绑定已有机器人。如果你以前授权过，请选择绑定已有机器人并选中原来那个；新建机器人会失去对旧机器人所建对象的编辑权限。
zh.qr_no_image: 二维码未能生成。请打开链接，在企业微信中完成授权后回到本页。
zh.qr_waiting: 等待扫码（5 分钟内有效）……
zh.qr_done: 授权成功，正在返回客户端……
zh.qr_failed: 授权未完成，请在 MCP 客户端中重新发起。
zh.qr_timeout: 已超时，请在 MCP 客户端中重新发起。
